listing.name: macOS Molten Patcher
listing.abstract: Kitten Space Agency mod that makes the Windows game run on macOS in a Sikarugir (Wine) wrapper
listing.description:
## ⚠️ Warning

- Only for macOS users running KSA inside a **Sikarugir** wrapper. Tested with KSA 2026.10.13.5602 on engine WS12WineSikarugir11.0_1.
- This is a highly experimental project. Proceed with caution.
- macOS is still not officially supported. Leave the devs alone.

---

A Kitten Space Agency mod that lets the Windows version of the game run on macOS in a Sikarugir (Wine) wrapper. A StarMap hook runs it before the game starts. It applies the patches in its `patches/` folder to the wrapper and the game files.

## How it works

Each patch is a plain text file: a title, an explanation of why it exists and when it can be removed, a --- line, then the change itself. There are two kinds:

.patch: a diff of one text file, as git diff prints it. Lines are matched by their text, not by line numbers, so a patch survives small changes to the file around it.
.replace: a whole file, for binaries. It names the target and lists the shell commands that build the new file (build.sh runs them); the built file ships in files/.
The target is a path inside the game folder, or inside the wrapper's Contents folder when it starts with wrapper:. Patches cannot reach anywhere else.

You can see the current list of patches in the Github repository or inside the mod patches/ folder. For more info, check the repo.
